+

+static void cpu_max_set_sve_max_vq(Object *obj, Visitor *v, const char *name,
+                                   void *opaque, Error **errp)

+    uint32_t max_vq;
+
+    if (!visit_type_uint32(v, name, &max_vq, errp)) {
+        return;

+        error_append_hint(errp, "Valid sve-max-vq in range [1-%d]\n",
